title: Frame Instagram exports without changing the photo edit
notes: Instagram crop recipes export 4:5, 3:4 or 9:16 sRGB JPEGs at 1080 px wide. Per-photo framing is remembered separately from the main crop and edit history. Existing padded recipes and ordinary export defaults retain their behaviour. The selected recipe survives panel remounts and restart; Export for Instagram opens the last Instagram recipe directly (4:5 initially).
